learning: Human authorization to run the Shadow Action layer does not force Capital Admission.
UNKNOWN = DENY propagates across the Research-to-Capital firewall when the accepted primary research settlement remains INDETERMINATE.
A large ex-post Gold rally and supported H2/H3 do not override the missing decisive H1 evidence gate.
A PositionPassport can exist as a cancelled zero-authority shadow artifact without creating sizing or trade authority.
A zero-scope synthetic ActionContract can test execution governance without submitting any order or invoking OMS/broker infrastructure.
Four-Way Reconciliation remains meaningful in a denial path: absent OMS/broker legs are explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE rather than silently assumed matched.
FAIL_CLOSED is a successful governance outcome when the system prevents unauthorized capital or execution escalation.
next_learning_question: What additional governed evidence would be required to resolve H1 without hindsight or mixed-vintage reconstruction?
